description: This file contains core utility functions for a web server module, including WSGI application setup, HTML caching, user authentication, and X-Sendfile handling.

methods.name: wsgi
methods.description: Sets up a WSGI application route based on a URI prefix and backend actions.

methods.name: cached_html
methods.description: Creates a cached HTML handler that serves pre-rendered HTML files when available and not already a file.

methods.name: auth_require_user
methods.description: Enforces user authentication by requiring specific usernames, matching the REMOTE_USER environment variable.

methods.name: xsendfile
methods.description: Provides file delivery functionality by integrating with the X-Sendfile mechanism, specifying a document root.
